location_description: Egg Harbor Township is a township in Atlantic County, New Jersey. The US Census Bureau in the 2020 census reported the population as 47,842, an increase over the previous decade. As of the 2010 U.S. census, the township's population was 43,323, reflecting an increase of 12,597 (+41.0%) from the 30,726 counted in the 2000 census, which had in turn increased by 6,182 (+25.2%) from the 24,544 counted in the 1990 census.Egg Harbor Township was first mentioned as part of Gloucester County in records dating back to March 20, 1693, and at times was called New Weymouth.
